## Technical Skills & Specializations
- **Cybersecurity & VAPT**: Attack surface mapping, Web Application Penetration Testing, OWASP Top 10 validation, vulnerability assessments.
- **Security Operations & SIEM**: Wazuh deployment, Suricata IDS, log telemetry pipelines, custom detection rules, MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
- **Forward Deployed Engineering**: Custom integrations, client workflow automation, production deployment, Linux server hardening.
- **Full-Stack & Systems**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Nginx reverse proxies, systemd daemons.
- **AI Automation & LLMs**: Local LLM inference (Ollama), autonomous agent workflows, safety constraints, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
